verse.verse_1: Inã rantsuwa da Attinu da Azzaitũn.
verse.verse_4: Lalle ne, Mun halitta mutum a cikin mafi kyawon tsayuwa.
verse.verse_5: Sa'an nan, Muka mayar da shi mafi ƙasƙantar masu rauni
verse.verse_6: Face waɗanda suka yi imani, kuma suka aikata ayyukan ƙwarai, saboda haka suna da sakamako wanda bã ya yankewa.
verse.verse_7: To, bãyan haka mẽ ya sanya ka ka ƙaryata sakamako (wanda za a yi a bãyan Tãshin ¡iyãma)?
verse.verse_8: Ashe Allah bã Shi ne Mafi mãsu hukunci kyãwon hukunci ba?
